description: arXiv:2606.21008v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a benchmark that is fully self-contained, needs no ground truth, and rises with the models it measures. Language models compete at making analogies and subjectively grade one another; nothing enters from outside. The benchmark reproduces GPQA Diamond, a keyed benchmark of expert-written questions, at r = 0.98, audited for a...
